title: GLOBAL TECH INDUSTRIES GROUP, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: This is a SEC Form 8-K filing for Global Tech Industries Group, Inc. (GTII), a micro-cap OTC Markets company in receivership, describing a Note Assignment Agreement involving Convertible Promissory Notes from AURI, Inc. and related conversion notices. The filing is entirely about private corporate debt restructuring and disclosure matters; it has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: GTII Receivership Estate entered into a Note Assignment Agreement with MSC Capital Advisors LLC on April 7, 2026
Two convertible promissory notes from AURI, Inc. (principal totaling $125,000) were assigned to the Receivership Estate
Notes are in default: Note 1 ($100,000 principal, 8% interest, matured Oct 2025) and Note 2 ($25,000 principal, matured Mar 2026)
Receiver delivered Conversion Notices on April 7-8, 2026 exercising conversion rights for 841,242,529 shares at $0.00005 per share
Remaining debt on AURI Notes totals approximately $103,515.96 after conversions
Receiver notified OTC Markets Group on April 17, 2026 that AURI failed to disclose the outstanding notes in its public filings
